set.rappels: From the Solid Gold anchors, rappel the back (north) side to the backside walk-off: two rappels by the route description, though some parties report one rappel on a single 60 m rope followed by a scramble to the notch below the West Ridge. No station list is published. Or continue to the summit and take the standard four-rappel summit descent.
set.rappel_count_note: Accounts of the short back-side descent from the Solid Gold anchors differ, one rappel or two, and none describes the stations, so no table is shown. The rangers rebuilt the anchors on this lower summit in 2018 after slings had piled up; back up whatever you find.
